bio.text: Adriel Lam is a Republican candidate for Hawaii's 1st Congressional District in the 2026 election, according to the Honolulu Star-Advertiser's election guide.

The guide lists Lam as 55 and retired, with previous jobs that include the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Pacific Ocean Division, U.S. Army Pacific, and a military liaison role at the U.S. Embassy Kabul.
Lam lists prior service as vice chair of the Kaneohe Neighborhood Board and vice chair of the Oahu Metropolitan Planning Organization, and self-describes as a fourth-generation Hawaii resident.
